name: OpenVibe.Website
tagline: Websites that work, not just pages.
description: openvibe.website opens OpenVibe.Space, the network's website and app builder: describe what you want and OpenVibe AI builds it as a space on your OpenVibe account, or start from a template, then edit and publish it, with static hosting for your own files.

pillars.title: Generate or code
pillars.text: Describe it, import it, fork it, or write it yourself.

pillars.title: Real features
pillars.text: Sign-in, forms, bookings, media, blogs and support from the network.

pillars.title: Your files
pillars.text: Every generated site is readable, editable source.

pillars.title: Publish anywhere
pillars.text: yourname.openvibe.website or your own domain, with rollback.
